mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 67 degrees and a waxing crescent moon in the sky.

The Verona Senior Center is currently seeking volunteers to help with their community programs. Volunteers need to commit to at least two shifts per month and should be prepared for some light physical activity. Please visit the city website to complete an application or stop by the front desk for a paper form.

Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or enjoy music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or take your kids to the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.

On August 8th, the Verona Police Department assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office with a burglary investigation. Using a department drone, officers tracked a suspect vehicle into a corn field and successfully located one of the suspects hiding nearby.
Today's featured flavor is Turtle. Since the restaurant is currently closed, please note they will open their doors at 10 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Mint Cookie.
